0.9.141.title: Compass Beta 0.9.141
0.9.141.intro: The music bar now shows up reliably when you play music.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: Fixed the music bar not appearing when you play a song.

sections.heading: Music
items: The music bar opens as soon as you play any track, switch to a different track, or hit a playback error. It still stays hidden at launch when the only thing there is the track restored from your last session.
